title: Fact-check as an agent
description:
Definition for `fact_check`: woken when the step is ready (after the free sources step), paid, behind the quiet window. A claim that is not verified is held with its reason and raises doubt; doubt stops automatic publishing at every rung. Builds on the paid fact check on drafts (PPY-e4f8c2).

**Acceptance criteria**
- A contradicted claim stops automatic publishing and raises a hard gate.
- The check runs once per changed claim, after the quiet window.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- fact-check-agent.feature: verified claims close the step; a contradicted claim raises a hard gate; an edit re-checks only changed claims.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M7 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
